notes:
LOSTAR 0.27.4 adds a clear Home update prompt with Review update, Later and Skip this version. Automatic checks run at most hourly while Home is visible; the optional six-hour background check remains available. Updates never install automatically or interrupt active playback.

Compact-phone Home headers keep the LOSTAR name readable, and updater spacing now follows screen density. Update and notification settings remain scrollable on smaller displays.

Prepared opt-in Firebase (Google Android) and Amazon Device Messaging (Fire OS) integrations, with a safe release sender and account setup guide. IMPORTANT: this release has no Firebase/Amazon push project configured. Instant closed-app alerts are not active yet; the app clearly shows that status. Existing manual and periodic update checks still work. A future configured build and physical-device delivery tests are required before enabling push.

Amazon remains a separate Appstore-managed edition, with no APK downloader or Google messaging SDK. No streaming content or provider credentials are included. Install over your existing direct app to keep playlists and settings; do not uninstall first.
